tasks.title: Calling of stored procedure is not case sensitive

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 大小写敏感数据库中的同名存储过程缓存串用，有完整建库和调用对照。

test_spec.setup: 使用大小写敏感文件系统且初始化lower_case_table_names=0；建db1、DB1，各建p1返回不同标记。
test_spec.steps: 依次CALL db1.p1()和CALL DB1.p1()；新会话反向调用作控制。
test_spec.oracle: 两个CALL必须返回各自数据库标记；记录缓存命中后是否错误返回第一个过程结果。
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标版本支持上述模式和存储过程；原报告有派生发行版细节，官方确认仅作为线索，实际仍需官方构建验证。

source.title: Calling of stored procedure is not case sensitive

header.Bug #112158: Calling of stored procedure is not case sensitive

comments.author: Frank Fan
comments.text:
Description:
When 
1. lower_case_table_names = 0 
2. There are databases with same name in different case
3. Those two DB contain stored procedure with the same name,

the same procedure would be called no matter which DB name is called.

For example, if we create database db1 and DB1, stored procedure db1.p1 and DB1.p1, db1.p1 will be called by both `call db1.p1();` and `call DB1.p1();`

How to repeat:
mysql> show variables like "%char%";
+--------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Variable_name            | Value                                                          |
+--------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| by_expr_ignore_charset   | OFF                                                            |
| character_set_client     | utf8mb4                                                        |
| character_set_connection | utf8mb4                                                        |
| character_set_database   | utf8mb4                                                        |
| character_set_filesystem | binary                                                         |
| character_set_results    | utf8mb4                                                        |
| character_set_server     | utf8mb4                                                        |
| character_set_system     | utf8                                                           |
| character_sets_dir       | /disk1/ziqian.fzq/code/installed_polar/current/share/charsets/ |
+--------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
9 rows in set (0.02 sec)

mysql> show variables like "%collation%";
+-------------------------------+--------------------+
| Variable_name                 | Value              |
+-------------------------------+--------------------+
| collation_connection          | utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci |
| collation_database            | utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci |
| collation_server              | utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci |
| default_collation_for_utf8mb4 | utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci |
+-------------------------------+--------------------+
4 rows in set (0.02 sec)

mysql> show variables like "lower_case_table_names";
+------------------------+-------+
| Variable_name          | Value |
+------------------------+-------+
| lower_case_table_names | 0     |
+------------------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.02 sec)

mysql> create database db1;
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.12 sec)

mysql> use db1;
Database changed
mysql> delimiter $$
mysql> create procedure p1()
    -> begin
    -> select "db1.p1";
    -> end $$
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.04 sec)

mysql> delimiter ;
mysql> create database DB1;
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.11 sec)

mysql> use DB1;
Database changed
mysql> delimiter $$
mysql> create procedure p1()
    -> begin
    -> select "DB1.p1";
    -> end $$
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.05 sec)

mysql> delimiter ;
mysql> call db1.p1();
+--------+
| db1.p1 |
+--------+
| db1.p1 |
+--------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> call DB1.p1();
+--------+
| db1.p1 |
+--------+
| db1.p1 |
+--------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

Suggested fix:
Stored procedure is stored in an unordered_map in sp_cache. No matter which value lower_case_table_names is, the key is a string whose collation is utf8_general_ci. Therefore, the stored procedure cannot be found correctly.
